notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.basis: Visually checked ventricular landmarks on original PDF 513

fields.basis: Course-standard 25 mm/s assumption; 150 independently detected small-square intervals across 738 pixels
fields.reason: Mean R–R estimate 73.4 bpm; six-second count estimate 70 bpm. All seconds/bpm depend on course-standard 25 mm/s. Count estimate assumes 150 small squares = 6 seconds; endpoint phase and partial complexes affect it. On irregular strips the count estimate is not a stable instantaneous rate. Mean RR describes only intervals between observed peaks.

fields.value: Candidate P-wave observation: Shallow pre-QRS elevations recur before several spikes, including the three measured cycles; some are only a few native pixels tall and merge with a gently sloping baseline. P identity remains uncertain. Similar temporal placement is visible before the second, third and fourth spikes. A definite one-P-for-every-QRS statement is not supported by all cycles at this resolution.
